purpose.summary: This is a CICS online program that handles customer inquiry requests. It validates the commarea, optionally checks a CICS Temporary Storage Queue for an 'MQ hit' flag, and then links to either LGICDB01 (the normal database inquiry program) or a placeholder program ('AAAAAAAA') to retrieve customer details. It is part of the IBM CICS Insurance Application sample (CB12).

notable_features: EXEC CICS commands: LINK, ABEND, RETURN, ASKTIME, FORMATTIME, ReadQ TS
EIB field usage (EIBCALEN, EIBTRNID, EIBTRMID, EIBTASKN)
COPY LGPOLICY and COPY LGCMAREA (external copybooks not shown)
Temporary Storage Queue read loop to detect MQ routing flag
Error logging via LINK to LGSTSQ utility program
verdict.notes: This is clearly part of the IBM CICS Insurance Application sample (CB12), a well-known IBM tutorial/demo application. The 'AAAAAAAA' program name used in the MQ-Hit branch appears to be a placeholder or test stub. Two COPY statements reference external copybooks (LGPOLICY, LGCMAREA) not included in the file. No SQL is present; all data access is via CICS LINK to a separate DB program.
